summary: Accumulate diagnostics from all statistics responses and apply available payloads even when another request reports an issue.
review: Independent patch generated directly from pinned base; production worktrees unchanged.
validation_plan: Permute success/error response order and assert successful fields survive with all diagnostics retained.
Cover all-success, all-failure, and payload-plus-warning responses on an initially uncached table.
Verify fatal future exceptions still propagate and no Success() status gate is introduced.
limits: Existing cache entries still require Q18; independent Q19 validates initially uncached application.
Future exception handling is unchanged; this patch does not swallow service/runtime exceptions.
Successful response constructors currently leave default status unset, so this patch deliberately does not gate on Success().
